units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:2">Sabb. XX, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 139b:11">139ᵇ</cite>) <he>מ׳ של חרדל</he> a mustard mixture in the strainer (v. Rashi a. l.). Ib. 134ᵃ <he>אין מסננין … במ׳ שלו</he> you must not strain a mustard mixture (on the Holy Day) in the strainer designated for it.
